## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem/Use Case

What problem does this solve? What use case does it enable?

## Proposed Solution

How would you like this feature to work?

## Alternative Solutions

Have you considered any alternative approaches?

## Examples

Are there examples of this feature in similar projects?

## Implementation Notes

(Optional) Any technical details or suggestions for implementation.

## Benefits

Who benefits from this feature and how?

## Additional Context

Any other information, mockups, or screenshots.
